title: The Bessel coefficient bound IS the Salem-Zygmund sub-Gaussian MGF — char-0 closes the chaining input, leaving only the char-p defect
reduced_to: The char-0 wiring is SOUND and formalizable: bessel_energy_le_gaussian (besselCoeff(n/2,r) <= gaussianCoeff(n/2,r) = (n/2)^r/r!) summed against lam^{2r}/(2r)! telescopes EXACTLY to exp((n/2)lam^2) = exp(sigma^2 lam^2/2) with sigma^2=n, the sub-Gaussian MGF; chernoff_max_re_le then gives B<=sqrt(2 n log m). So the F5(moment)/F16(MGF) duality really is one Bessel inequality, and besselEnergy_implies_subGaussianMGF (the named open input SubGaussianMGF, in char 0) is dischargeable. BUT the open core is unchanged: the MGF the finite-field Gauss period eta_b actually has is governed by the CHAR-P energy E_r^{Fp}, not the char-0 E_r^inf the Bessel brick bounds. The wiring requires E_r^{Fp}=E_r^inf up to r~log q. That transfer is exactly CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold, which is VACUOUS at prize scale (phi(2^mu)=n/2 => p^{1/phi}=1.00000005 at n=2^32,p~n^5 => clean range r<0.5, while r_opt~log q/2~55). So the residual is the FULL open Bourgain-Shkredov/BGK sqrt-cancellation wall, NOT a small char-p anomaly at r~beta.
wall: W-BGK (the char-p energy transfer E_r^{Fp}=E_r^inf to depth r~log q is the Bourgain-Shkredov/BGK equidistribution wall; CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean declares its own clean range VACUOUS in the prize regime phi(n)=n/2, exactly where C019 needs it).
evidence:
Three probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ (exact integer arithmetic, PROPER dyadic subgroups, prizelike beta=log_n p). (1) C019_idealized_char0_chain.py: GRANTS char-0 E_r<=(2r-1)!!n^r for all r and confirms the WIRING is sound -- the telescope sum_r (2r-1)!!n^r lam^{2r}/(2r)! = sum_r (n/2)^r/r! lam^{2r} = exp((n/2)lam^2) is EXACT (verified (2r-1)!!/(2r)!=1/(2^r r!) to 1e-15, and gaussianCoeff(d,r)=d^r/r! exactly). min_r (q(2r-1)!!n^r)^{1/2r} tracks sqrt(2n log m) (ratio 1.18->1.12 from n=8 to the prize n=2^32,q~n^5, r*=111; the residual ratio is the discrete-r artifact, the Carleman closed form gives sqrt(2n log m) exactly). (2) C019_bessel_mgf_charp.py: EXACT char-p energy E_r^{Fp}(mu_n)=#{2r-tuples summing to 0 mod p} via mod-p sumset convolution, at n=8,16,32 and several primes. The char-p defect (E_r^{Fp} > (2r-1)!! n^r) onsets at r_break=2 or 3 (a CONSTANT), e.g. n=32 p=257 r_break=2, n=16 p=193 r_break=2 -- NOT at r~beta; and (q E_r^{Fp})^{1/2r} stagnates near n (saturated by the defect) and never reaches sqrt(2n log m) at any single r. (3) C019_threshold_match.py: confirms the residual the attack-plan names (CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold) is the clean-range edge (2r)^{phi(n)}

r_clean_max=0 while r_opt~55.5 (full tower-depth gap). This matches the in-tree honesty contract: CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean lines 54-62 declare itself VACUOUS for n=p^{1/beta}, phi=n/2, and CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean already proves the same r_max~2 log_n p cap (best provable B~n^{3/4+o(1)}, not sqrt(n log)).
honest_note: Two-sided. CORRECT and genuinely useful in C019: (i) the char-0 Bessel->MGF wiring is mathematically sound and FORMALIZABLE -- the telescope is exact (I verified the (2r-1)!!/(2r)!=1/(2^r r!) identity and gaussianCoeff=d^r/r!), so besselEnergy_implies_subGaussianMGF is a real clean Lean lemma waiting to be written (proxy sigma^2=n, not the 'O(n)' the SalemZygmund file leaves abstract); (ii) the observation that the F5 moment route and F16 MGF route are the SAME Bessel inequality is correct and not previously wired. OVERCLAIMED and the decisive correction: 'char-0 closes the chaining input, leaving only the char-p defect at r~beta (W-anomaly)' is wrong about the residual's SIZE. The Bessel brick bounds the char-0 energy E_r^inf; the object the Gauss-period MGF consumes is the char-p E_r^{Fp}. The defect E_r^{Fp}-E_r^inf onsets at r=O(1) (exact probe: r_break=2-3), the clean range never reaches the needed r~log q (CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold vacuous at phi=n/2, by the file's own admission), so the residual is the FULL open Bourgain-Shkredov/BGK wall, identical to the wall already named in GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean and CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean -- not a new small anomaly. This duplicates the C006 finding (sub-Gaussian MGF(sigma^2) <=> all even moments E_r<=(2r-1)!!sigma^{2r}) and sharpens it: C019 correctly identifies that the char-0 SIDE of that equivalence is ALREADY a proven in-tree theorem (the Bessel brick), pinning the gap to be PURELY the char-p transfer. So this is a sharpened FRAMING (a formalizable char-0 wiring + exact localization of the gap) that welds back to W-BGK; no closure. Caveats: probes use exact integer mod-p energy and float64 for |eta_b| at small n,p (prize-scale computation infeasible); I did not build the cited oleans (no lock taken) -- the Lean lemmas' axiom-cleanliness is asserted by their in-file #print axioms and read proofs, not re-run; the besselEnergy_implies_subGaussianMGF Lean lemma is identified as sound+writable but was NOT written/compiled here.
